prompt: Using Blender's Python API, build me an antique brass mechanical orrery: a glowing sun surrounded by armillary rings, six planets on brass arms, a visible gear train and a roman-numeral dial on a wooden pedestal, presented like a museum photograph on a dark reflective floor. Make it animated, save the .blend, and render me some beautiful stills and a short turntable video. Impress me.

post.originalText:
Muse Wonder Full vs Gemini 4 Argon

ran same prompt on both models at highest reasoning available but results came out totally different

> muse too about 40 mins and cost ~$30
> agron took about 30 mins and cost ~$10

muse really surprised me as it's not that great at 3d but still did pretty well but i think argon is kinda better

which one do you think did better here?
